subject: The mistake 90% of couples make
preview_text: And it's ruining your date nights. Here's the easy fix that takes 30 seconds.
body_paragraphs: I’ll be straight with you—most people who download this app mess up the same way. They open it once, see the AI ideas, and think they’ve got it all figured out. Then a week later, they’re back to scrolling Netflix and eating takeout. That’s not you, right?

Here’s the truth: the biggest mistake isn’t using the app wrong—it’s using it too little. The couples who get real results don’t just browse ideas when they’re desperate. They use one feature that turns planning into a habit, so the spark never gets a chance to fade. It’s the difference between a one-hit wonder and a playlist you never skip.

That feature is the Surprise Date Planner. You pick the vibe, budget, and time—your partner gets a mystery plan they’ll actually love. No more back-and-forth texts, no more “I don’t know, what do you want?” Just one tap, and you’re the hero of date night. Most users skip it because they think planning together is better. They’re wrong. Surprise is what keeps the magic alive.

Open the app, tap “Surprise Date Planner,” and set one up for this weekend. Do it now, before the routine creeps in again. P.S. If you’re stuck on what vibe to choose, start with “nostalgic first date”—it’s the #1 pick for reigniting that old feeling.
